blocks.english: Where there are several candidates, two or three may be ordained together provided they have the same preceptor. verses.pali: สุณะสิ โอภาสะ,
verses.english: Listen, Obhāsa. This is the time for truth, the time for what is so. What has arisen, that I ask you. If it is present, say it is present; if it is absent, say it is absent. Do you have afflictions of these kinds?

สันตัง อัตถีติ วัตตัพพัง,
อะสันตัง นัตถีติ วัตตัพพัง,
สันติ เต เอวะรูปา อาพาธา.
(ถาม) กุฏฐัง ฯลฯ โก นามะ เต อุปัชฌาโย,
verses.english: (Asked:) Leprosy … what is your preceptor's name? (Answered:) There is none, venerable sir … my preceptor, venerable sir, is the venerable Sobhaṇa.

verses.pali: (ตอบ) นัตถิ ภันเต ฯลฯ อุปัชฌาโย เม ภันเต อายัส์มา โสภะโณ นามะ.
verses.pali_roman: Natthi bhante … upajjhāyo me bhante āyasmā sobhaṇo nāma.

checks.issue: ⚠ THE BOOK ABBREVIATES WITH ฯลฯ, THE THAI ET-CETERA MARK, and it appears TWICE in one line — '(ถาม) กุฏฐัง ฯลฯ โก นามะ เต อุปัชฌาโย, (ตอบ) นัตถิ ภันเต ฯลฯ'. The full list of afflictions and the full set of answers are NOT printed; the book expects the reciter to know them. Reproduced exactly as set. This is the first place in the backward pass where the book abbreviates rather than prints, and no text has been supplied to fill the gap.

checks.issue: ⚠ THIS IS THE SINGLE-CANDIDATE FORM AND PAGES 297-298 CARRY THE PAIR FORM. Here the candidate is โอภาโส and the preceptor โสภะโณ, and every clause is singular; on 297-298 the candidates are ปุณโณ and สุโภ under มะนุสสะนาโค and every clause is dual. The book's own note on page 296 says exactly why — the case endings and number must change. Two chants, not one printed twice.

A WORD BROKEN ACROSS A LINE BY A HYPHEN — the first announcement prints 'อุปะสัม-' at a line end and 'ปะทาเปกโข' at the next line's start, for อุปะสัมปะทาเปกโข. Rejoined; the hyphen is the compositor's and is not carried into the text. Same treatment as page 314's namodham-/māya.

THE SECOND ANNOUNCEMENT IS CUT BY THE PAGE BREAK. Its opening clauses are at the foot of 295 and the rest at the top of 296, so the 296 portion carries para_layout and deliberately NO para_start — the page-75 rule, as on page 307.
